## Critical Risk Areas

### RISK-001: Authentication Bypass
- **Area:** Login / Authentication
- **Risk Level:** Critical
- **Description:** Any defect in authentication logic could allow unauthorized access to user data
- **Impact:** Full system compromise, data breach, regulatory violation (GDPR/HIPAA)
- **Test Coverage:** 100% (18 test cases)
- **Status:** COVERED

### RISK-002: Session Token Management
- **Area:** Session Management
- **Risk Level:** Critical
- **Description:** Improper session invalidation after logout enables session hijacking
- **Impact:** Account takeover, unauthorized data access
- **Test Coverage:** 90% (4 session test cases)
- **Status:** COVERED

### RISK-003: SQL Injection in Input Fields
- **Area:** All input forms
- **Risk Level:** Critical
- **Description:** Unsanitized inputs could allow database manipulation
- **Impact:** Data exfiltration, data corruption, full database compromise
- **Test Coverage:** 75% (Login form covered; registration and profile forms pending)
- **Status:** PARTIAL — Action Required

### RISK-004: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Enforcement
- **Area:** Authorization
- **Risk Level:** Critical
- **Description:** Improper RBAC could allow regular users to access admin functions
- **Impact:** Data exposure, unauthorized system administration, privilege escalation
- **Test Coverage:** 85%
- **Status:** MOSTLY COVERED

---

## High Risk Areas

### RISK-005: Password Reset Flow
- **Area:** Password Recovery
- **Risk Level:** High
- **Description:** Insecure password reset could allow account takeover without knowing the current password
- **Impact:** Account compromise for any user
- **Test Coverage:** 0% — NOT IN SCOPE (excluded as restricted area)
- **Recommendation:** Add to next sprint — high priority

### RISK-006: Data Validation on Form Submission
- **Area:** All forms
- **Risk Level:** High
- **Description:** Missing server-side validation could allow malformed data into the system
- **Impact:** Data integrity issues, application errors, security vulnerabilities
- **Test Coverage:** 60% (client-side validation tested; server-side bypass not yet tested)
- **Recommendation:** Add server-side validation bypass test cases

### RISK-007: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
- **Area:** All state-changing operations
- **Risk Level:** High
- **Description:** Missing CSRF tokens could allow malicious sites to perform actions on behalf of logged-in users
- **Impact:** Unauthorized actions performed in user's name
- **Test Coverage:** 30%
- **Recommendation:** Add CSRF validation to all POST/PUT/DELETE operations

### RISK-008: File Upload Security
- **Area:** Profile Photo Upload, Document Upload
- **Risk Level:** High
- **Description:** Unrestricted file uploads could allow malicious files to be uploaded and executed
- **Impact:** Remote code execution, XSS via SVG, server compromise
- **Test Coverage:** 0% — requires dedicated upload test suite
- **Recommendation:** Add file upload security tests in next sprint

### RISK-009: Sensitive Data Exposure in Browser
- **Area:** All pages
- **Risk Level:** High
- **Description:** Sensitive data cached in browser storage could be accessible to other scripts
- **Impact:** Data exposure via XSS, insecure storage
- **Test Coverage:** 20%
- **Recommendation:** Audit localStorage, sessionStorage, and cookies for PII

### RISK-010: Error Message Information Disclosure
- **Area:** Error Handling
- **Risk Level:** High
- **Description:** Verbose error messages could reveal system internals (stack traces, DB schema, server versions)
- **Impact:** Reconnaissance data for attackers
- **Test Coverage:** 50%
- **Recommendation:** Test all error states for information disclosure

### RISK-011: Third-Party Script Injection
- **Area:** All pages (analytics, chat widgets)
- **Risk Level:** High
- **Description:** Third-party scripts loaded without Subresource Integrity (SRI) hashes could be compromised
- **Impact:** Malicious code execution in user browsers
- **Test Coverage:** 0% — requires CSP/SRI audit
- **Recommendation:** Add CSP header validation tests
